name: notevault
description: Production-oriented AI-assisted Markdown notebook with Firebase Auth, FastAPI, Firestore, typed OpenAPI contracts, and cross-browser E2E tests.

scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.contract:generate: python backend/scripts/export_openapi.py && npm --prefix frontend run contract:generate
scripts.contract:check: npm run contract:generate && git diff --exit-code -- backend/openapi.json frontend/src/features/notes/generated.ts
scripts.check: npm run release:check && npm run typecheck:frontend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:backend:coverage && npm run contract:check && npm run build:frontend
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:firebase-integration
